name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
notes: Pinned to the official model revision above. Thinking-mode sampling defaults are temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0, presence_penalty=0 and repetition_penalty=1. The official 1M-context guidance allocates up to 262144 reasoning tokens plus 131072 final-response tokens; Ember still clamps both to actual context room. Static factor-4 YaRN is advisory and off by default; it requires the explicit runtime opt-in and is not yet certified to fit or perform on a 128 GiB Strix Halo UMA host. Qwen only accepts low, medium and xhigh reasoning-effort names at the prompt ABI. Non-thinking requests should explicitly use the official 0.7/0.8/20 sampling settings and presence_penalty=1.5; a single sidecar cannot select sampler defaults conditionally.
